name: zizmor Open-Source CI Security Scanner
free_limit: MIT-licensed local CLI for static analysis of GitHub Actions, Dependabot and pre-commit configurations; no vendor scan quota or software subscription fee.
watch_out: Runs locally or on user-provided CI runners. GitHub Actions runner minutes may cost money; optional GitHub code-scanning/SARIF upload can require GitHub Advanced Security for private repositories, but CLI scanning does not. This is not a hosted free security scanning service.
